about_the_game:
🌍 Terra Fighters

The world is your weapon in this Earth-slinging 2D platform fighter where global champions battle to save their crumbling home.

Terra Fighters is a fast-paced, physics-based fighting game that blends platform combat, arena destruction, and local couch multiplayer mayhem.
Pick up the very ground beneath your feet and hurl it at your opponents—the arena itself becomes your weapon.

🪨 Hurl the Earth. Hold Your Ground.

Knock your friends into the abyss below in a wild, arcade-style brawler that’s part snowball fight, part platform battler.
Pick up blocks of terrain (“Terra”), toss them with precision, and watch as the stage slowly collapses beneath your feet.

Throw behind and watch your projectile circle back around the Earth for a surprise strike.
Catch incoming blocks mid-flight to steal an opponent’s attack.
Deflect blocks—or even opponents— to reverse the flow of battle.
Charge a picked-up Terra to make it fly faster and hit harder—perfect for clutch knockouts.
Stay alert—the last fighter standing wins in this high-energy local multiplayer arena.

🌎 Seven Defenders. One Fragile Home.

Each fighter represents a homeland —from Kifaru the Rhino of Africa to Malu the Kangaroo of Australia.
Master each warrior’s signature elemental Terra ability—from teleport traps to freezing blocks to explosive blasts—and unleash devastating combos.

Battle across hand-drawn, destructible arenas inspired by regions around the globe.
Dynamic hazards—lightning storms, shifting platforms, timed collapses—keep every round unpredictable and intense.
Start with seven playable fighters, and unlock six hidden champions as you progress.

📖 Story Mode: The Rift Beyond the World

A cataclysmic time rift has fractured the planet, twisting the balance of nature across every continent.
Kifaru, the young rhino warrior from Africa, sets out to uncover the source of this global anomaly.

Each battle brings him closer to the truth—but what he discovers is deeper, darker, and more mysterious than he could have imagined.
Unite the world’s defenders and confront the unseen force threatening to tear reality apart.

👊 Local Showdowns. Global Stakes.

Grab a friend for explosive local versus matches, or go solo in Story Mode to master your skills and unlock new characters.
Whether you’re in it for the laughs, the strategy, or the challenge, Terra Fighters delivers competitive couch co-op action with global flair.

Protect your home.
Save the world—one Terra at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD A8-5600k
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 630 / Radeon HD 6570
  • Storage: 60 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-650 / AMD A10-5800K
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 / Radeon HD 7510
  • Storage: 60 MB available space

short_description: Pick up the Earth and fight back! A chaotic 2D platform fighter where global champions throw, deflect, and destroy the arena itself in fast-paced local battles.
